example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চতুর্দশীর চাঁদের মতো ভরা যৌবনে আছে।
এই বয়সে তিনি চতুর্দশীর চাঁদের মতো সুন্দর।
example_sentences_in_english: She is in the prime of youth like the full moon on the fourteenth day.
At this age, he is like the moon in full bloom, full of youthful vigor.
note: Refers to the almost full moon on Chaturdashi, symbolizing peak beauty and vitality in Bengali poetic tradition.
